articles.title: Interactive Storytelling App OOC Introduces Halloween Event with Special Rewards
articles.summary: Have you ever been watching an anime and felt like you just wanted to step into that world? Well, OOC: The Playable Anime was created to offer exactly that experience, and right now it’s hosting a Halloween event with special rewards that allow newcomers to experience more stories.
body: For the uninitiated, OOC is interactive storytelling and roleplaying app that lets you become the protagonist and actively participate in how a story unfolds. There’s a preset world with its own lore, characters, and starting point, but where things go from there is based on what you type. You make choices and use custom prompts to shape the story’s twists and turns, and those choices can dramatically alter the characters and story. What if you had the power to determine whether the serial killer in a horror story ultimately wins? You can do that during OOC’s Halloween.

Whatever story and world you choose to dive into, characters remember your previous conversations and decisions, allowing relationships to naturally develop. As the storyline and world are shaped by your choices, scenes become more vivid and immersive thanks to images that reflect how these scenes play out. Every time you experience a story, it’s exclusive to you alone.

Some stories are OOC Originals from the app itself, while others are created by members of the community, which you can do too. There are currently more than 52,000 stories and more than 58,000 characters to interact with.
points: Have you ever been watching an anime and felt like you just wanted to step into that world?
Well, OOC: The Playable Anime was created to offer exactly that experience, and right now it’s hosting a Halloween event with special rewards that allow newcomers to experience more stories.

articles.title: Walter Koenig, Star Trek's Chekov, Dies at Age 90
articles.summary: Walter Koenig, who played Chekov on the original Star Trek series, has died at age 90. “The late actor's rep tells us... Walter's daughter, Danielle, and his niece were by his side when he died of old age at his home in North Hollywood on Sunday,” TMZ reports.
body: Koenig joined the NBC series Star Trek in its second season as the USS Enterprise’s Russian crewmember Ensign Pavel Andreievich Chekov. With his Beatles-style mop of hair, the boyish Chekov was meant to appeal to younger viewers a la Davy Jones of The Monkees.
As Chekov, Koenig would appear in the latter two seasons of the original series and then in all six feature films featuring the cast.
With Koenig’s death, only William Shatner (Captain Kirk) and George Takei (Mr. Sulu) remain alive from the original cast.

Marvin Walter Koenig was born in Chicago on Sept. 14, 1936. The Hollywood Reporter recounts that he studied at Neighborhood Playhouse in New York alongside future sci-fi and comedy icon Christopher Lloyd, who would star opposite Koenig in Star Trek III: The Search for Spock.

articles.title: Why There Won’t Be A Helldivers 3 Anytime Soon, If Ever
articles.summary: Helldivers 2 has been a huge hit for developer Arrowhead and publisher Sony, but don't expect a third game in the series anytime soon. Arrowhead's chief creative officer, Johan Pilestedt, told Rock Paper Shotgun that a sequel would reset "everything" and force the player to "start over." He doesn't…
body: "Some studios can treat players like a short-term cash grab," Pilestedt said. "We see players as the actual engine of the game: they're the ones bringing in friends, making memes, and keeping the game alive. When you have an active community doing that, you don’t need a sequel."

He went on to say that the video game industry today is "panicking" because "the old live-service tricks don't work anymore," and that would also apply to a hypothetical Helldivers 3. If Arrowhead were to make a sequel, it would need to be highly differentiated, he said.

"The biggest competitor to a Helldivers 3 would be Helldivers 2. It only makes sense to make a distinct sequel if it’s so different that both games can exist side by side. For now, making Helldivers 2 better every day makes way more sense than throwing away its momentum," he said.
Pilestedt added that 95% of the studio is working on Helldivers 2 right now, with only a small team assigned to work on whatever the team is making next.

articles.title: PlayStation Handheld May Have Exclusive Next-Gen AMD Graphics, Report Suggests
articles.summary: Sony may have exclusive access to AMD's next-generation graphics architecture for a potential PlayStation handheld, the tech experts at Digital Foundry have said. There have been rumors of a next-generation PlayStation handheld for some time now, after the success of the Nintendo Switch and a wide…
body: When I watched the latest Patreon-exclusive DF Direct, Digital Foundry's Richard Leadbetter claimed that "there's been some behind-the-scenes discussion that Sony has an exclusive of sorts with AMD for RDNA 5 for handheld," and that the only other, presumably handheld, chip he knows of in production at AMD is what's going to be known as Z3, which is unlikely to have RDNA 5 graphics.

AMD and Sony have been working closely for the last couple of years, teaming up on an initiative called 'Project Amethyst,' which ultimately resulted in both PSSR 2 on the PS5 Pro and FSR 4.1 for PC and Xbox.

Speaking of Xbox, it sounds like Microsoft has handheld gaming plans of its own. Project Helix will include a whole range of devices, we were recently told, and a handheld will reportedly be the first out the gate. Fortune recently reported that Microsoft plans to release a handheld by holiday 2027, with the next-gen console following in 2028. The chips going into either of these platforms hasn't been confirmed, but AMD did come out and tease that FSR Diamond would be launching with Project Helix – of which the handheld is a part of – and that would likely be running on RDNA 5.

articles.title: Amazon Has a Genuine Forged Damascus Steel Pocket Knife for Less Than $27 Ahead of Black Friday
articles.summary: Start your holiday shopping early and score some big savings. Ahead of Black Friday, Amazon is offering the CVLIFE 3.26" Damascus Pocket Knife for just $26.69 after coupon code " EGCGXDOW ". That's 40% off its original $45 list price.
body: The major selling point of this knife - and it's confirmed in the reviews - is that it is genuine forged Damascus steel. According to the seller, it is comprised of a VG10 core and 66 layers of folded steel. The reason why Damascus steel is so popular is its unmistakeable patterning. It looks beautiful, it holds up faily well to daily abuse, and it resharpens well.

The 8" knife itself consists of a 3.26" long blade that folds into a 4.6" long non-slip G10 fiberglass composite handle. The folding mechanism features a ball-bearing pivot system and an intuitive thumb stud with a liner lock that the seller touts as having zero blade play. An integrated pocket clip also adorns the side. All-in-all, the knife weighs about six ounces, which is pretty solid for such a small knife. CLIVE offers a 5 year warranty.

articles.title: Cyberpunk 2077 Hits Its Biggest Steam Player Peak Since Phantom Liberty, And You Can Guess Why
articles.summary: Almost six years after launch, Cyberpunk 2077 still has a healthy player base, especially with a new anime spin-off driving people to the Night City source material. The second season of Edgerunners launched last week alongside a beefy update for Cyberpunk 2077, and unsurprisingly, PC player…
body: At the time of writing, Cyberpunk 2077 player numbers had surged to 187,215 players on PC via Steam alone. That's the biggest peak since October 2023, when the game received the substantial Update 2.0 and the Phantom Liberty expansion. This new tick in players is likely being experienced on other PC platforms where the game is available (like GOG and the Epic Games Store), as well as on multiple consoles like PS5, Xbox Series X|S, and Switch 2.

With a new update that adds dual-wielding, new cosmetics, customizable cyberware fashion, even more digital tourism, and a new story mission linked to Edgerunners, it's no wonder that player numbers are climbing again. You also can't discount Edgerunners' impact, as the Netflix anime series is likely driving an influx of new players.

The first season of Edgerunners is credited with playing a major role in Cyberpunk 2077's revival after its infamous December 2020 launch, and Edgerunners Season 2 probably makes a good case for returning to the game. CD Projekt Red has also discounted Cyberpunk 2077: Ultimate Edition by 70% on Steam, so the entry price is pretty cheap right now.

articles.title: Arkane Lyon Gets Another Chance To Find A New Home And Finish Marvel’s Blade
articles.summary: Arkane Lyon has received a slight reprieve from its looming deadline to find a new buyer, as Microsoft says it is exploring allowing another company to support the developer's efforts to get Marvel's Blade over the finish line.
body: Originally, it was reported that Arkane Lyon had until November 18 to find a new owner or risk the studio being shut down. Microsoft had initially announced that it was divesting itself of the developer-- and several others --earlier this year, but under French Law, it was legally required to spend at least three months searching for a new buyer for the studio. Speaking to PC Gamer, a Microsoft representative said that the "consultation period" had been extended by one more month and that it was continuing to "explore options," such as "finding a partner" to support Arkane Lyon.
Last week, Bloomberg's Jason Schreier added that he'd be surprised if Arkane Lyon were actually shut down, as doing so would be expensive for Microsoft.

articles.title: Xbox Game Pass Is Now Included With A Phone Plan
articles.summary: Microsoft has announced a new way to subscribe to Xbox Game Pass, and it's part of your phone plan. T-Mobile has announced a new offering called "T-Mix," and it allows users to pick and choose the services they want included in their plan--one of the options is Xbox Game Pass.
body: T-Mix rolls out in November, and at that point, people can choose Game Pass Ultimate or Premium to be included with their phone plan. Microsoft noted in its announcement that this is the first time ever that Xbox Game Pass has been available through a wireless plan in the US.

The T-Mix plans start at $55/month for one line, and this includes one pick that could be Game Pass. T-Mix More is $75/month and includes two picks; T-Mix Loaded is $95/month and includes three picks.

One thing that people may want to be aware of before signing up is that Game Pass itself could be set for a shakeup soon. According to reports, Xbox is plotting a "major overhaul" of the service to give players the ability to choose features à la carte. In April this year, it was reported that Microsoft was preparing to launch a “pick-your-own” version of Game Pass, so the latest reporting tracks with that.

Game Pass was a big bet that did not pay off, Xbox CEO Asha Sharma has said, so it makes sense to hear she may be planning to overhaul it. She’s already undertaken efforts to change things up, including removing new Call of Duty titles from the program and lowering the price.

articles.title: Fire Emblem: Fortune’s Weave Actor Based Fabio On an Iconic Disney Villain
articles.summary: It's been several weeks since the launch of Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave, and fans around the world are still sinking their teeth into the massive strategy RPG. With a sprawling cast featuring dozens of unique characters, it's no small feat for one to emerge as a clear fan favorite.
body: Yet that's precisely what's happened with Fabio, the condescending scholar of mysterious origins who becomes Dietrich's right-hand man in the Heroic Games tournament. Actor Jimmy Yamaguchi's heartfelt and often hilarious performance has contributed immeasurably to the character's popularity, and he recently revealed the unexpected inspiration for Fabio's voice in an interview with Polygon.

"His accent is actually probably more like a mid-Atlantic accent. Someone who has lived in multiple places. So it's not distinctly anything. One of the inspirations, at first, was Jeremy Irons," Yamaguchi told Polygon. "When I got the specs, before I started reading the lines, I did something like, 'Well, I was first in line... until the little hairball was born.' And then I went into the line as I did it, so that way, I could kind of get an idea."

As someone had to voice those sounds, there is a credit for Korra in episode 7, "What Lies Beneath." This revealed that Cia Court is the new voice of Korra.

Court is best known for roles such as Vi in League of Legends and Himeko in Honkai: Star Rail. She takes over the role from Janet Varney, who was the original voice of Korra. Jacqueline Grace Lopez also voiced the character earlier this year in Avatar Legends: The Fighting Game.

Uncovering what really happened during the cataclysm and why Korra seems to have gone mad is a central part of the show. articles.title: Xbox Studio On Brink of Closure Gets More Time To Find a Home and Finish Marvel's Blade
articles.summary: The last few months at Xbox Studios have been a bloodbath. Microsoft announced in July that it would be cutting 3,200 jobs from its Xbox division in the coming year and has since made over 1,800 cuts. As part of those layoffs, Xbox also announced it would cut several beloved game studios.
body: Beyond Ninja Theory, Dishonored developer Arkane Lyon seems to be the last major studio that Microsoft is considering closing as part of its ongoing “reset.” Arkane Lyon is based in France, which has stronger labor laws than the U.S. and many other countries, so Xbox must undergo a consultation process to “review potential strategic options” about what to do with the studio.

As per PC Gamer, French outlet Le Monde previously reported that while Xbox intended to shut down Arkane, France’s “Florange Law” requires companies with more than 1,000 employees to seek potential buyers first. Originally, the deadline for Arkane to find a buyer was Nov. 13, 2026, after which Microsoft would seemingly be free to close the studio. Several months into the consultation process, Arkane still does not appear to have found a buyer.

articles.title: Control loreheads shouldn't put too much stock into what The Board says in Control Resonant - the devs say it's "basically gibberish"
articles.summary: One of Control and Control Resonant's most memorable stylistic choices is how The Board - an alien entity whose true nature is a mystery, and whose morals and motivations are never made clear - communicates with the player.
body: Clearly, developer Remedy knew exactly how The Board should sound coming out of your speakers. While there's no consensus, many have theories about what The Board is truly saying - and that's in part because of the way it sounds.
Except, it turns out what you hear shouldn't be taken very seriously.

"An important part of the design is that The Board is basically gibberish, not affiliated to any language," Control Resonant audio lead Lucas Pierrot told Gamespot. "So, when you hear a word, you tend to hear what you want to hear… and that's pretty neat in terms of audio design, as players can fulfill their fantasies."

The Board speaks an oblique language and in a very bassy voice, making it hard to make out what's being said from voice alone. The games' subtitles offer what could only be considered an interpretation of some of what's being said, but they alternate between different words for similar concepts to make it even harder for The Board's speech to have a definitive meaning.

articles.title: As beloved Dishonored studio faces closure, Xbox agrees union request to extend negotiations deadline in hope of saving 217 jobs
articles.summary: Xbox has extended Arkane Lyon's consultation period by around a month, as the search for a new owner continues. If one isn't found, the studio will likely be shut down.
body: Arkane Lyon - the developer behind immersive sims including Dishonored and Deathloop - was one of several first-party studios impacted by Xbox CEO Asha Sharma's sweeping "reset", which will result in 3,200 job losses by the time the process is complete. Arkane's leadership was reportedly informed of Xbox's intention to close the studio on 16th July, but France's Florange Law meant a three-month search for a buyer must first be undertaken.

Last week, unions - Printemps écologique and Syndicat des Travailleureuses du Jeu Vidéo - were said to be fighting to buy more time for negotiations. And now, as per a new report by Le Monde, Microsoft has agreed to extend the original 13th November deadline to December. If a buyer still isn't found, 217 jobs are at risk.

Documents published on the French government's website in August referenced a plan for "the complete and permanent cessation of the company's activities" and another for the "dismissal of all employees for economic reasons."

videos.title: DF Direct Weekly #287: Xbox Helix $1200-$1800? BioWare Shut, FSR 4 RDNA 2 + Xbox, Sony Frame Gen!
videos.summary: Many thanks to Alienware for sponsoring this video. To learn more about Alienware’s 39-inch 5K OLED Gaming Monitor, check it out here:
body: Big news this week from Fortune, with an insider feature on Xbox that combines deep access to senior management along with a range of big reveals: a Helix console costing between $1200 to $1800 coming 2028? A handheld in 2027? Disagreements between the Xbox and Microsoft OS teams? There's a lot to discuss here. Meanwhile, the team lament the end of BioWare and mull over the leaked Mass Effect trailer, and there's good news for RDNA 2 GPU owners - and Xbox Series console users - as FSR 4 arrives ahead of time. A potential PlayStation frame generation technique is discussed and finally, five years of Oliver Mackenzie at Digital Foundry! The panel look back at his first video and discuss his approach to working on the channel.

videos.title: Marvel Cosmic Invasion - DLC #2: New Game Mode Trailer | PS5 & PS4 Games
videos.summary: MARVEL Cosmic Invasion: The Siege of Castle Doom DLC is coming November 10 to PS4 and PS5!
body: Race against time as the Siege Gauge fills, and stop Doctor Doom before he can activate the deadly Cosmic Inductor in the upcoming Castle Doom's game mode!
- Gather Battery Cells and complete challenges to earn defense, damage or tactical upgrades from a collection of 12 different perks
- Choose your path through Castle Doom’s winding routes and thoughtfully select buffs to alter your combat abilities to become an unstoppable powerhouse
